# Magnoliya Grand Conference & Event Center

> Official venue information for Magnoliya Grand, a conference and event venue at 7001 Infantry Ridge Rd, Manassas, Virginia 20109.

Canonical website: https://magnoliyagrand.vercel.app/
Contact: sales@magnoliyagrand.com | +1 703 843 5536
Location: 7001 Infantry Ridge Rd, Manassas, VA 20109

## Verified venue facts

- The Magna Ballroom is 14,500 square feet and can divide into four rooms.
- Maximum capacity is up to 1,200 guests in banquet style and up to 2,000 guests in theater style.
- Final capacity depends on staging, dance floors, audiovisual footprint, service stations, and room configuration.
- Magnoliya Grand is approximately 12 miles from Dulles International Airport and 25 miles from Washington, D.C.
- The venue is connected to Hilton Garden Inn Manassas.
- Amenities include in-house catering, professional audiovisual capabilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, complimentary parking, private preparation suites, green rooms, waterfront spaces, and landscaped gardens.
